title: Holde'm Back :We’re making a tower defense roguelike where your poker hand decides who fights for you
author: DevandaLabs
selftext:
Anyone here remember the StarCraft poker defense maps?

We used to play them growing up, and that idea of summoning units through poker hands stuck with us. So we built Hold'Em Back around it and added our own twist: roguelike runs, fighters you can merge, and a deck you can reshape as you go.

Sharing some gameplay here. If you played those maps too, we’d love to hear what you remember about them. And if this looks like something you’d enjoy, a wishlist would mean a lot to us ❤️

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5016950/Holdem\_Back/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5016950/Holdem_Back/)

PS. the demo is coming SOON so stay tuned

AI disclosure: Some artwork and visual assets were created using generative AI.
